thread:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — hotfix held but we need a crisp runbook update + owners for remediation.
Samir Das: agree. We should add a compact triage checklist and exact pasteable commands for oncall. I'll help author.
Ben Ortiz: include KV cache health checks and a minimal diagnostic bundle. Example cmds to paste: ```kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference logs $POD -c inference --tail=200
curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache```
Sienna Ko: I'll own remediation work. Proposal: 48h spike for TTL + batch-cap matrix, then a 10-day sprint to harden autoscaler + graceful degrade. Spike results due Thu EOD.
Maya Patel: runbook triage flow draft: 1) confirm impacted routes/models, 2) run diagnostic bundle, 3) check node pressure & kubelet eviction logs, 4) warm fallback route, 5) page SRE if >2 pods evicted from same pool within 15m.
Ben Ortiz: add PromQL snippets to the runbook for quick checks. e.g. `sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[5m])) by (node)` and the kv hit ratio metric.
Infra Bot: Created ticket INF-6102 "Eviction cascade: runbook + remediation" and assigned Sienna, Ben, Maya.
Samir Das: action owners: Maya -> runbook PR by Fri EOD, Sienna -> spike + load tests by Thu, Ben -> alerts + automation by next Wed. Put dates in INF-6102.
Maya Patel: will open PR this afternoon with triage steps, pasteable commands, PromQL, escalation thresholds, canned Slack text, and rollback recipe.
Sienna Ko: spike plan posted in INF-6102: TTLs=[15s,30s,60s], batch_caps=[48,56,64]; running load tests Fri 09:30 PT. Will post results and recommendation.
Ben Ortiz: after runbook merges I'll add a small script that collects the diagnostic bundle and prints a one-line summary for oncall to paste in the thread.
Maya Patel: Thanks — scheduling a 15-min check-in Fri 11:45 PT after the load test to decide sprint scope. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
